sub_graphs.title: Cancun Blocks: Validator Withdrawal Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of validator withdrawals from consensus layer to execution layer

nodes.label: Withdrawal Pending from Consensus Layer
nodes.description: Withdrawal request exists on beacon chain, awaiting execution layer processing

nodes.label: Validate Withdrawal Fields
nodes.description: Verify withdrawal has valid index (U64), validator_index (U64), address (Address), and amount (U256)

nodes.label: Withdrawal Validated
nodes.description: Withdrawal fields verified, ready for inclusion in block

nodes.label: Include Withdrawal in Block
nodes.description: Add withdrawal to block's withdrawals tuple

nodes.label: Withdrawal Included in Block
nodes.description: Withdrawal committed to block, will be processed during block execution

nodes.label: Credit ETH to Recipient
nodes.description: Add withdrawal amount to recipient address balance

nodes.label: Withdrawal Complete
nodes.description: ETH has been credited to recipient address

external_entities.name: Beacon Chain (Consensus Layer)
external_entities.description: The Ethereum proof-of-stake consensus layer that provides validator withdrawal requests

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Blocks: Block Header Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation of block header fields including EIP-4844 blob gas fields

nodes.label: Block Header Received
nodes.description: Raw block header data received from network or block producer

nodes.label: Validate Parent Hash
nodes.description: Verify parent_hash matches RLP-encoded hash of parent header

nodes.label: Validate Ommers Hash
nodes.description: Verify ommers_hash equals EMPTY_OMMER_HASH (PoS has no ommers)

nodes.label: Validate State Root
nodes.description: Verify state_root matches root hash of state trie after executing transactions

nodes.label: Validate Transactions Root
nodes.description: Verify transactions_root matches Merkle-Patricia trie of transactions

nodes.label: Validate Receipt Root
nodes.description: Verify receipt_root matches trie hash of transaction receipts

nodes.label: Validate Withdrawals Root
nodes.description: Verify withdrawals_root matches commitment to validator withdrawals

nodes.label: Validate Blob Gas Fields
nodes.description: Verify blob_gas_used (U64) and excess_blob_gas (U64) are valid per EIP-4844

nodes.label: Validate Parent Beacon Block Root
nodes.description: Verify parent_beacon_block_root matches corresponding beacon chain block

nodes.label: Block Header Valid
nodes.description: All header fields validated successfully

nodes.label: Block Header Invalid
nodes.description: Header validation failed, block rejected

edges.label: State root valid, check tx root
Blob gas valid, check beacon root

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: P2P network peer that transmits block headers

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Blocks: Receipt Encoding and Decoding
sub_graphs.description: Models how transaction receipts are encoded/decoded based on transaction type

nodes.label: Raw Receipt Data
nodes.description: Receipt data before type-aware encoding/decoding

nodes.label: Determine Transaction Type
nodes.description: Identify if transaction is Legacy, AccessList, FeeMarket, or Blob type

nodes.label: Encode Legacy Receipt
nodes.description: RLP encode receipt without prefix for Legacy transactions

nodes.label: Encode AccessList Receipt
nodes.description: Prefix receipt with 0x01 byte before RLP encoding

nodes.label: Encode FeeMarket Receipt
nodes.description: Prefix receipt with 0x02 byte before RLP encoding

nodes.label: Encode Blob Receipt
nodes.description: Prefix receipt with 0x03 byte before RLP encoding

nodes.label: Receipt Encoded
nodes.description: Receipt properly encoded with type-specific prefix

nodes.label: Decode Receipt
nodes.description: Parse prefix byte to determine type, then RLP decode receipt fields

nodes.label: Receipt Decoded
nodes.description: Receipt fields available: succeeded, cumulative_gas_used, bloom, logs

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Blocks: Event Log Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models how event logs are created and processed during transaction execution

nodes.label: Contract Code Executing
nodes.description: Smart contract bytecode is being executed by EVM

nodes.label: Emit Log Event
nodes.description: Contract executes LOG opcode with address, topics (up to 4 Hash32), and data

nodes.label: Log Event Created
nodes.description: Log struct populated with address, topics tuple, and data bytes

nodes.label: Add Log to Receipt
nodes.description: Append log to receipt's logs tuple

nodes.label: Update Bloom Filter
nodes.description: Add log address and topics to 2048-byte bloom filter

nodes.label: Log Committed to Receipt
nodes.description: Log included in transaction receipt, bloom updated

ambiguities.text: The relationship between blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas is not fully defined in the block header alone.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume blob_gas_used tracks actual consumption per block while excess_blob_gas is cumulative tracking for fee calculation. Cross-reference with EIP-4844 for complete semantics.

ambiguities.text: The difficulty and nonce fields are described as 'constant' and 'zero' but exact values are not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume difficulty=0 and nonce=0x0000000000000000 as per post-merge specifications.

implicit_assumptions.description: The beacon chain (consensus layer) is trusted to provide valid withdrawal requests.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious withdrawal requests could create ETH out of thin air or credit wrong addresses.

implicit_assumptions.description: RLP encoding/decoding is deterministic and consistent across all implementations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different nodes could compute different receipt roots, causing consensus failure.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot forge parent_beacon_block_root values that pass validation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could enable attacks that rely on manipulating RANDAO or other beacon state.
